'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Matt Jourdan LS We'll Handle This (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Jourdan]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This (V) / Duel Of The Fates (V)|VB5-L-wellhandlethis-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Jedi Deck
* '''Username:''' Fishfleas
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
